scope: bounded car-sequence image/clock registration with frozen independent vehicle checks; no phase inference
candidate_origin_interpretation: JSON first detection minus15s from provisional vehicle-sequence review, not accepted clock truth
training_requirements: at least2 car tracks,6 image points, noncollinear geometry; observed native PTS and explicit candidate identities
validation_policy: freeze training model before scoring distinct car IDs; preserve failed/ambiguous associations, no refit from validation
rate_policy: constant offset is a tested local hypothesis, not assumed globally; discrepancies must not be repaired by phase alignment
